changelog: Fixed the quick menu freezing when acn_bridge was not up to date.
Quick menu driven by the arrow keys while moving, Alt shows a cursor. Requires acn_bridge 2.11.0.
Searches open the real inventory, only when the person is cuffed, down or has their hands up.
New hands up with a smooth animation and walking handcuffs by default.
Clock in on the duty NPC, new quick list menu. Requires acn_bridge 2.10.0.
The police menu now lives in the target, with nested menus on vehicles and anywhere.
Radial menu is optional with no default key.
New design and icons on every screen. Requires acn_bridge 2.9.0.
First release of the rebuilt police job: duty, handcuffs, escort, searches, citations, fleet, armory, uniforms, impound, BOLO and officer GPS.
Server-read speed cameras, portable cameras, patrol radar and traffic control with spike strips, road zones and stop orders.
Every setting can be changed in game with /conf_acn_policejobV2. Requires acn_bridge 2.8.1.
